notes.title: Commander Bug Wars #GameUpdate 6
notes.content:
We bring exciting new updates for Commander Bug Wars, a new Terran unit, and some minor improvements.

Patch Notes:

Color Bug Fix:
- We've addressed the issue with the scrolling bar colors, ensuring that the UI is visually consistent and easier to navigate.

New Unit: Terran Air Transport
- A new Terran Air Transport unit has been added to the game, giving players new strategic options for moving units across the battlefield. This air-based unit allows for rapid deployment of ground troops, offering more flexibility in large-scale tactical operations.

Additional Fixes & Adjustments:
- Fine-tuned UI elements for smoother navigation in menus and maps.
- Minor adjustments to unit selection for better accuracy in targeting during combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921119/bc7ebb437f484b14897a2c585c050141c5c0661c.png[/img]

Thank you for your continued support, stay tuned for more!

notes.title: Commander Bug Wars is Officially Released!
notes.content:
After months of development and feedback, everything promised during Early Access is now live! With the latest update, the game is complete, and we’re excited to celebrate the full release of Commander Bug Wars! 🛠️

Thank you to everyone who supported us through Early Access—you made this possible. To mark this milestone, stay tuned for special events and updates. The war between the Terrans and Cybernetic Bugs has never been this intense!

To celebrate the release, we’ve introduced several exciting new features in the latest update:

[list]
[*] New Terran Abilities: Unlockable once the Commander unit is built, now you can use the Drop Pod (heroic infantry), AT infantry, and Orbital Bombardment.
[*] New Bug Abilities: Unleash the Swarm Delivery (4 bug infantry), Multi-Swarm (3 different bug units), and Acid Eruption.
[*] Fixed bug where units were deselected after last chance to attack with no moves left.
[*] Added a MAC version.
[*] Fixed mouse movement issue at different frame rates.
[*] Added frame rate options for smoother gameplay.
[/list]


Thank you for all the support! Ready for battle?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921119/4b07ca94fc64a63d6ab1d5c0fdc20f5b1292c697.png[/img]

notes.title: Commander Bug Wars #GameUpdate 5
notes.content:
We bring exciting new updates for Commander Bug Wars, new features, fixes, and gameplay improvements.

Patch Notes:

[b]New Animations:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added corrosive death animations for Marine units.
[*] Implemented death animations for Mech units, including Walker, Artillery, and SAM.
[*] All Bug units now feature death animations, expanding on the previously added animations.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the Bug faction couldn't recruit the Infector unit.
[*] Corrected a problem where the Terran SAM would incorrectly explode on air units when targeting ground units.
[/list]
[b]Balance Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Rebalanced unit stats for both Terran and Bug factions to ensure fair gameplay.
[*] Rebalanced units veterancy for all tiers.
[/list]
[b]Gameplay Enhancements:[/b]
[list]
[*] When selecting a base, if a unit has no move points, the recruitment screen will now automatically open.
[*] Added credits per turn information for better resource management.
[*] Added a new feature to promote a unit to Commander, granting instant max veterancy and unlocking special Commander abilities (still in development).
[*] Mouse-over displays for veterancy now show bonuses.
[/list]
[b]Achievements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added 2 new achievements to challenge players.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921119/215183f988e64339097795c106f1edf0a6518b3b.png[/img]

Thank you for your continued support, stay tuned for more!

notes.title: Commander Bug Wars #GameUpdate 4
notes.content:
We bring exciting new updates for Commander Bug Wars, new features, fixes, and gameplay improvements.

Patch Notes: Commander Bug Wars

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]:
[list]
[*] Resolved an issue where bug units would appear damaged even when out of sight.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented Cruise Missiles from spawning if the unit was deselected before appearing.
[*] Corrected a problem where explosions created crates on water tiles.
[*] Fixed a bug allowing underground units to capture locations.
[*] Addressed an issue where air units on top of enemies would be selected while targeting the enemy.
[*] Corrected incorrect faction colors for the yellow Bug faction.
[/list]
[b]New Features & Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] Campaign Mode: A campaign has been added for an extended gameplay experience (WIP).
[*] Map Editor: The Spiker and Infector units are now available in the map editor for custom scenarios.
[/list]
[b]Gameplay Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Mines placed by the same team will no longer explode when triggered by friendly units.
[*] Fixed a bug allowing the plague ability to spread while attacking at range.
[*] Added additional effects when firing rounds and enhanced death animations for Terran infantry.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921119/116eff4d72d5331504b2379670e1fb7e2fe73d64.png[/img]

Thank you for your continued support, stay tuned for more!

notes.title: Commander Bug Wars #GameUpdate 3
notes.content:
We’re excited to share the latest updates for Commander Bug Wars, bringing new features, fixes, and gameplay improvements. Here’s what’s new:
[list]
[*] We’ve corrected the road-building feature so that only Terran infantry units (Gunner class) can construct roads, ensuring the game mechanics work as intended.
[*] Color Palette Customization, anew feature allows players to customize the game’s color palette according to their selected color. This adds a personalized touch to your gameplay experience.
[*] New Ability: Anti-Infantry Bug Jump
[*] The Anti-Infantry Bug unit now has a Jump ability, allowing it to cover ground quickly and launch surprise attacks on enemy forces.
[*] Construction Restrictions, road construction is now restricted on walls and in forests. This change maintains the integrity of natural obstacles and strategic structures within the game.
[*] Bug Fix: Hex Grid Display
[*] We’ve resolved an issue where the hex grid selection would incorrectly display after starting a new game and selecting the map. This fix ensures a smoother start to your games.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921119/f011c1f7560b147624059bb2f5cc89527cbcfd6e.png[/img]


Thank you for your continued support, stay tuned for more!

notes.title: Commander Bug Wars #GameUpdate 2
notes.content:
Commander Bug Wars is evolving, and lets share the exciting latest additions and changes that will enhance your gameplay experience:

[b]New Bug Unit: The Infector[/b]

The battlefield just got more dangerous with the introduction of the Infector. This unit sprays a toxic slime that can plague Terran units, spreading the infection to nearby forces. Be strategic to avoid a widespread epidemic!

[b]New Terran Unit: Guided Missile[/b]

The Cruiser naval unit now comes with added firepower! The Guided Missile can be launched to strike enemies with precision, giving your fleet a powerful edge in naval engagements.

Auto-Capture Locations Option

We've added a new option for auto-capturing strategic locations on the map. This feature is turned on by default, streamlining your conquest efforts without the need for manual capture commands.
Terran Infantry Construction: Roads

Terran infantry units now have the ability to build roads. These roads are specifically designed to accommodate APCs and tanks, enhancing mobility and enabling quicker deployment of heavy armor across the battlefield.

Improved Unit Selection

We've refined how units are selected, making it easier and more intuitive to command your forces. This improvement aims to provide a smoother and more enjoyable experience during intense battles.

Your feedback has been invaluable in shaping these changes, and we look forward to hearing your thoughts on the new features!

Happy commanding, and as always, thank you for your support!

notes.title: Commander Bug Wars #GameUpdate
notes.content:
🚀 Commander Bug Wars Weekly Update 🚀

Commanders, we've got some exciting improvements and new features for you this week!

🛠️ Fixes and Enhancements:
[list]
[*] Turn Counter: Resolved issues with the turn counter for smoother gameplay.
[*] Multi-Player Refresh: Fixed the refresh after next turn for games with more than one human player.
[*] Unit Selection Shortcut: The next/previous unit button shortcut now only selects units with available move points.
[*] Memory Leak: Fixed a memory leak issue that could crash the game.
[/list]
New Features:
[list]
[*] Terran Tank Smokescreen Ability: Unleash tactical smoke curtains with your Terran Tanks! This new ability blocks line of sight, giving you a strategic edge.
[*] Map Editor: Create and customize your own battlefields with our brand-new map editor!
[*] Your feedback and support continue to drive the evolution of Commander Bug Wars. Dive into the game, explore the updates, and let us know what you think!
[/list]

See you on the battlefield, Commanders!
